subject.title: Export installed agents as grouped Claw packages

question: Should experimental `claws export` require an exact healthy managed installation in v1, or should it support an explicit degraded snapshot mode with a machine-readable drift report?
rationale: Both paths are plausible, but they create materially different portability, recovery, and support contracts that cannot be selected from implementation details alone.

options.title: Keep strict healthy-state export
options.body: Require complete, verified managed state and fail clearly on drift or unavailable sidecars; defer snapshot export until its semantics are designed.

options.title: Add an explicit snapshot mode
options.body: Permit degraded export only behind a named mode that emits a structured drift report and clearly excludes unrecoverable local state.

recommendation.title: Keep strict healthy-state export
recommendation.body: Require complete, verified managed state and fail clearly on drift or unavailable sidecars; defer snapshot export until its semantics are designed.

likelyOwner.reason: He is assigned to the PR and has already reviewed the concrete portability and identity invariants in this export path.
